ارتضختم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخْتُمْ (irtaḍaḵtum) /ir.ta.dˤax.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخْتُمْ (urtuḍiḵtum) /ur.tu.dˤix.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
